title: Reporting Autopilot
summary: The weekly ops/exec report assembled from live systems, narrated, and delivered on schedule.

trigger.description: Every Monday 07:00 client-local; ad-hoc runs on request.

agents.name: data-puller
agents.role: Pulls the week's numbers from CRM, ad platforms and sheets; verifies totals cross-foot before anything else runs.

agents.name: assembler
agents.role: Builds the report tables and charts; flags metrics that moved more than the noise band.

agents.name: narrator
agents.role: Writes the executive narrative: what moved, why we think so, what we are doing about it. Exception-first, no filler.

rollback: Disable the schedule; the report template and source queries remain documented in the runbook so a human can produce it manually.
